import importlib.util,json,tempfile,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd()
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('edge_acceptance',root/'scripts/test-public-production-runtime.py')
r=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(r)
checked=[]
r.build_edge_image()
try:
 with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
  env,_,_=r.synthetic_inputs(d)
  config=r.edge_test_config(r.adapt(r.CADDYFILE.read_text(),d))
  with r.Edge(d,env) as edge:
   for label,clients in r.BURSTS:
    if label not in ('BFF navigation per-source','identity per-source','emailed action per-source','shared household','registration per-source','recovery per-source','verification mail per-source'):continue
    edge.load(config,gate="ready")
    errors=r.run_scenario(edge,config,label,clients)
    assert not errors, errors
    checked.append(label);print('Passed: '+label,flush=True)
   text=r.CADDYFILE.read_text()
   for old,new in r.AGGREGATE_SCALE:text=text.replace(old,new)
   scaled=r.edge_test_config(r.adapt(text,d))
   for label,clients in r.AGGREGATES:
    edge.load(scaled,gate="ready")
    errors=r.run_scenario(edge,scaled,label,clients)
    assert not errors, errors
    checked.append(label);print('Passed: '+label,flush=True)
 Path('/tmp/vgp-increment8-edge.json').write_text(json.dumps({'kind':'focused-real-edge','outcome':'passed','scenarios':checked,'realHostCapacityAccepted':False},indent=2)+'\n')
finally:
 subprocess.run(['docker','image','rm','--force',r.EDGE_TEST_IMAGE],capture_output=True)
